liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Me & My Uncle** (2 reviews): Reviewer says they've never heard a better Me & My Uncle, and ranks Deal and Black-Throated Wind similarly [8][9]
- **Playin in the Band** (2 reviews): Reviewer sees Playin' as the show's most significant moment, a cosmic, space-bound jam; Reviewer names Playin, Bird Song and Greatest Story as many people's favorite versions [12][16]
- **I Know You Rider** (1 review): Reviewer found China/Rider not the best, but a string broke a quarter of the way through [19]
- **Greatest Story Ever Told** (1 review): Reviewer hears Jerry emerge as if from a quasar, with wah-wah playing that invites air guitar [14]

## Setlist highlights

- **Stage Announcements, Intros, Gift Presentations**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **Jazz Star" Jam**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Playin Jam, Playing In The Band Reprise [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1972-08-27.sbd.serafin.8045.sbefail.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 200 min; rated 4/5 by 11 [1]. Said about its sound: Plastic tape reels caused static during PCM archiving of sets one and two, due to electrical charge from winding [1]
- **gd1972-08-27.sbd.hollister.2199.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 202 min; rated 5/5 by 6 [2]. Said about its sound: A few small static spots remain in Dark Star, with small clicks at 25:34 and 26:35 [2]
- **gd72-08-27.sbd.orf.3328.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 188 min; rated 4.83/5 by 80 [3]. Said about its sound: An old '89-era tape sounded bad; this version keeps all the between-song talking [13]
- **gd1972-08-27.sbd.kaplan-hamilton.152.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 196 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [4]. Said about its sound: Lacks the small clicks and pops in Dark Star that affect most circulating copies; Sound-system distortion or buzziness appears in places, such as the start of Promised Land [4]
- **gd72-08-27.sbd.braverman.16582.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 188 min; rated 4.75/5 by 57 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls this source excellent, a big step up from an early hissy, barely listenable tape; Reviewer likes the sound quality; stage banter sits at the end of preceding song tracks, not separate tracks; Reviewer's stream of this copy lacked the opening Promised Land [11][17][19]

## Around the show

- Banter between tracks is kept on this copy, giving the feeling of being at the show [8]
- Banter between tracks is kept on this copy, giving the feeling of being at the show [9]
- The sun was setting and stars appearing as the set with Dark Star began [16]
- Widely held as the best Dead show; falls after the Europe tour and Pigpen, with jazz-fusion stretching [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1972-08-27.sbd.serafin.8045.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Jay Serafin; source: (SET I and II) SBD > Re-Mixed Master RTR > DAT > SSSB. (SET III) SBD > Re-Mixed Master RTR > PCM (via analog inputs and outputs) > DAT > SSSB [1]. Also: Masters came from a Marin County source; the uploader found the show among the hardest he'd worked on [1]
- **gd1972-08-27.sbd.hollister.2199.sbeok.shnf**: source: Master Betty reel > PCM > DAT > ZA2 > CD > EAC > SHN [2]. Also: Set 3 has an unknown number of PCM generations; David Hollister cleaned up pops [2]
- **gd72-08-27.sbd.orf.3328.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD-> two-track MR-> DAT-> Sonic Solutions-> CDR-> EAC-> Sound Forge Edit (analog pop removal using pencil tool)-> Sound Forge Pitch Shift (antialias filter… [3]. Also: Stems from a David Gans seed, passed via Adam Jerugim to Leigh Orf, who fixed it up [3]
- **gd1972-08-27.sbd.kaplan-hamilton.152.shnf**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Seth Kaplan, G. Hamilton; source: SBD > Master Reel [4]. Also: Copy came from Seth Kaplan; uploader calls it the cleanest of several versions heard over five years [4]
- **gd72-08-27.sbd.braverman.16582.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard [5]. Also: Notes that Jay Ashley released an upgrade of Bertha, and that an official video release is still rumored; Described as an upgrade over the dankseed version, and better than the reviewer's own copy [11][18]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Old Renaissance Faire Grounds - August 27, 1972](https://www.dead.net/show/august-27-1972) [21]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Flyer - Sunshine Daydream](https://www.dead.net/archives/1974/artwork/flyer-sunshine-daydream) [22]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Flyer - Old Renaissance Faire Grounds](https://www.dead.net/archives/1972/artwork/flyer-old-renaissance-faire-grounds) [23]
